stories.title: Elif Eralp'in seçim başarısı annesi Hülya Eralp'i gözyaşlarına boğdu: 'Çocukluğundan beri adaletsizliğe müdahale ederdi'

en.title: Elif Eralp's election success moves her mother Hülya Eralp to tears: 'She has challenged injustice since childhood'
en.summary: Elif Eralp, the Left Party's lead candidate in Berlin state elections, achieved significant electoral results. Her mother expressed pride, noting her daughter's lifelong commitment to justice and human rights.

stories.title: Yıllardır herkes farklı biliyordu: Sivas ismi meğer buradan geliyormuş

en.title: Everyone knew it differently for years: It turns out Sivas got its name from here
en.summary: The true origin of the name of the Anatolian city of Sivas has been revealed, contrary to what was previously believed by the public.

stories.title: Türkiye Sinema Festivali başlıyor: 75 ilde biletler 90 liradan satışa çıktı

en.title: Turkey Cinema Festival begins: Tickets go on sale at 90 lira across 75 provinces
en.summary: The second Turkey Cinema Festival will take place on September 26-27 across approximately 1,500 theaters in 75 provinces, featuring 17 domestic and foreign films at a fixed ticket price of 90 lira.

en.title: Operation against criminal organizations in Bursa: 1 arrested
en.summary: Law enforcement conducted an operation targeting individuals connected to criminal organizations in Bursa, resulting in one arrest.

stories.title: Sivas’ta LPG dönüşüm servisinde patlama: 5 kişi yaralandı

en.title: Explosion at LPG conversion service in Sivas: 5 people injured
en.summary: An explosion occurred at an LPG conversion service in Sivas, resulting in five people being injured.

stories.title: Kadını katletti, sabaha kadar başında bekledi: 'Annenizi öldürdüm' diyerek oğlunu aradı

en.title: Man kills wife, waits by her side until morning: calls son saying 'I killed your mother'
en.summary: An 80-year-old man in Kapaklı, Tekirdağ killed his 75-year-old wife following an argument and remained by her body until morning before informing their son, leading to his detention by police.

stories.title: Son dakika... Trafik kazası mağdurlarının kişisel verilerini kullananlara operasyon: 4 ilde 6 avukatlık ofisi ile 20 şirkete arama ve gözaltı!

en.title: Operation against those using personal data of traffic accident victims: searches and detentions at 6 law offices and 20 companies in 4 provinces
en.summary: Turkish authorities conducted operations targeting the illegal acquisition and transfer of personal information from traffic accident victims to law firms and damage assessment companies, with investigations initiated against 825 individuals.

stories.title: Oto LPG servisinde patlama: 5 kişi yaralandı

en.title: Explosion at auto LPG service: 5 people injured
en.summary: An explosion occurred during vehicle maintenance at an LPG conversion service in Sivas, injuring five people.

stories.title: Son dakika... 6 avukatlık ofisi ve 20 şirkete eş zamanlı baskın!

en.title: Breaking news... Simultaneous raids on 6 law offices and 20 companies!
en.summary: The Justice Minister reports that personal data of citizens involved in traffic accidents was obtained through illegal means, leading to coordinated enforcement actions against multiple legal and business entities.

stories.title: Sakarya'da evlat dehşeti! 16 yaşındaki çocuk annesini kurşun yağdırarak katletti

en.title: Family tragedy in Sakarya! 16-year-old boy kills mother by shooting
en.summary: A 16-year-old fatally shot his 34-year-old mother during an argument in Sapanca district and seriously wounded another person present at the scene.

stories.title: Tartıştığı eşini öldürüp oğlunu aradı: Beni polis teslim edin, annenizi de defnedin

en.title: Man kills wife he argued with, calls son: Turn me in to police, bury your mother
en.summary: An 80-year-old man fatally stabbed his 75-year-old wife during an argument in Kapaklı district and subsequently contacted their son asking to be surrendered to authorities.

stories.title: 16 yaşındaki çocuk annesini silahla ateş edip öldürdü

en.title: 16-year-old boy shoots and kills his mother with gun
en.summary: A 16-year-old opened fire on his mother and another person during an argument in Sapanca, resulting in the mother's death and serious injuries to the other individual.

stories.title: CUMHURBAKANLIĞI KUPASI: Fenerbahçe Tarfin Beşiktaş basketbol maçı ne zaman, saat kaçta, hangi kanalda?

en.title: PRESIDENCY CUP: When is the Fenerbahçe Tarfin versus Beşiktaş basketball match, what time, and which channel?
en.summary: Fenerbahçe Tarfin and Beşiktaş are playing each other in the Presidency Cup basketball competition. Details about the match's date, time, and broadcast channel are being sought.

stories.title: Konum verileri başını yaktı: Google'a 400 milyon Euro'yu aşan dev ceza

en.title: Location data caused trouble: Google hit with fine exceeding 400 million euros
en.summary: Google received a penalty exceeding 400 million euros for GDPR violations related to processing user location data. A six-year investigation found users may not have been aware their location information was used to determine advertisements and interests.

stories.title: Kadir İnanır’ın vasiyeti ortaya çıktı: Tüm mirasını bir kişiye bırakmış

en.title: Kadir İnanır's will revealed: He left his entire inheritance to one person
en.summary: Details emerged about the 2022 will of Turkish cinema legend Kadir İnanır, who left all his material and moral rights to his wife Jülide Kural. If Kural is not alive when the inheritance is opened, he requested it be distributed equally among three institutions.

stories.title: Ukrayna Devlet Başkanı Zelenskiy: BM’de barışa nasıl ulaşılacağını konuşacağız

en.title: Ukraine President Zelenskiy: We will discuss how to achieve peace at the UN
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy stated he will address how to achieve peace during meetings in the United States as part of UN General Assembly activities.

stories.title: Motorin fiyatı petrolden koptu: Türkiye’de yüzde 61 arttı, Avrupa’da rekor kırıldı

en.title: Diesel price decouples from oil: rises 61 percent in Turkey, record broken in Europe
en.summary: Diesel prices have surged independently from crude oil due to Middle Eastern supply disruptions, refinery constraints, and low inventory levels. The EU average pump price reached a 2026 record at 2.26 euros per liter, while Turkey saw a 61 percent increase since late February.
